name: openfang
notes: Closest architectural twin to Brain: Rust, Wasm-sandboxed tools, SQLite session log, HTTP/SSE surface. The single highest-value comparison.
18k stars against eight weeks of silence. Confirm the project is alive before treating its numbers as the rival's.

Pinned to commit acf2587e46be, cloned 2026-08-28. Built with -p openfang-cli -p openfang-api: a full workspace build pulls in openfang-desktop and fails on GTK, which has nothing to do with the server being measured.

create.definition: session create call until the session will accept a message

ttfb.definition: message submitted until the first assistant output byte on its SSE stream; pointed at the scripted provider through its OpenAI-compatible model config

round_trip.definition: message submitted until the turn is complete

resident.definition: private memory across the openfang process tree including forked Wasm workers, held minus post-discard, per session

throughput.definition: complete turns per second across N concurrent sessions

persistence.definition: bytes on disk in the OpenFang home after N turns of one agent, sampled per turn; OpenFang keeps sessions in SQLite
